title.zh: 从免费代理到正规物理专线平替迁移指南：零成本安全出海与合规网络配置
title.en: Migration Guide: Transitioning from Dangerous Free VPNs to Enterprise Dedicated Circuits Safely

cluster.zh: 免费 VPN 风险雷达与供应链剖析

description.zh: 为迷茫的初级用户量身定制的无痛安全平替迁移手册，涵盖流氓免费软件的彻底卸载、系统证书与代理注册表清理，以及如何用极低成本（如百元年付或永久包）平滑过渡到企业级 IEPL 专线。
description.en: A step-by-step migration guide for safely uninstalling free VPN malware, purging rogue root certificates, and transitioning affordably to enterprise IEPL dedicated circuits.
